# prova

> prova (tests with memory, experiments with proof) is a single Rust CLI that coding agents use to run a project's existing test command with fast, structured feedback: first failure while the suite runs, slow and stalled tests without long timeouts, per-test history (new, failed before, flaky), and statistical performance experiments with a frozen protocol. Run tests only through prova: `prova run <suite> --until first-failure` (returns within 30 s) or `--until done` (the result; continue with the printed `next:` command, never a shell loop), rerun one test with `--select`, check `prova history <test>`, and use `prova exp` for any claim that a change is better (faster, fewer steps, more accurate). For algorithms and protocols, write and check a specification first and pass it to `prova exp new --spec <file> --oracle <cmd>`: violating candidates are rejected unmeasured. `run`, `wait`, `status`, `output`, `history`, `flaky`, `diff`, `sizes`, `adopt` and the `exp` reports accept `--json`; `prova events <run>` prints JSON Lines. Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fals/prova/main/install.sh | sh`, or in the image where the tests run `COPY --from=ghcr.io/fals/prova:v0.1.1 /prova /usr/local/bin/prova` (the image holds only the binary). Exit codes: 0 passed, 1 test failure, 2 usage, 3 stall/slow/killed, 4 infrastructure, 5 still running.

## Use prova

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, adopt an existing project, the test loop, experiments, MCP
- [Contracts for agents](docs/architecture.md#contracts-for-agents): commands, exit codes, JSON events, configuration
- [Event schema](schemas/event.v1.json): JSON Schema of the event stream
- [Skill: test loop](skills/prova-test/SKILL.md): how an agent runs and fixes tests with prova
- [Skill: adopt a project](skills/prova-adopt/SKILL.md): put an existing test command under prova without editing it
- [Skill: experiments](skills/prova-experiment/SKILL.md): any objective (time, steps, accuracy), native benchmark tools, protocol, verdicts
- [Skill: specification first](skills/prova-spec/SKILL.md): formalize a problem (Quint by default, a typed syntax for TLA+'s logic; TLA+ or Lean when the project needs them), check it, use it as the oracle that gates experiments
- [Language skills](skills/): prova-rust, prova-go, prova-python, prova-ts, prova-java, prova-csharp

## Understand prova

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): components, code map, diagrams of the test loop, liveness, storage, experiments, invariants
- [Vision](docs/vision.md): the problem statement

## Work on prova

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for contributors; prova is tested with prova (`.prova/stable/bin/prova run small|medium|spec|large`)
- [Fixtures](fixtures/README.md): one project per supported language, used by large tests
